title: B3: dynamic field options / cascading selects (option.visibleWhen) — remaining: server enforcement, live e2e, ADR
body:
> **Rewritten 2026-07-15.** The core of B3 was designed and shipped via #2284 (per-option `visibleWhen` — design + client implementation) and #2215 (dependent query-backed lookups), landing in objectui **v12.0.0** (`226fde9`). This issue now tracks the **remaining dual-side scope**, including the items left unshipped when #2284 was closed. Original framing (`optionsWhen` as an open question) is superseded — see *Decided* below.

## Context

Follow-on to B2 (conditional rules, ADR-0036). Enterprise-form need: a select/lookup whose **available options depend on another field** (country → state) or on context (role/tenant/time), with the same dual-side philosophy as B2 — client UX + server enforcement, one CEL dialect.

## Decided (was "Open questions")

- **Authoring shape: per-option `SelectOption.visibleWhen` (CEL) + field-level `dependsOn`** — *not* a field-level `optionsWhen` predicate, *not* Salesforce-style `validFor`/dependency matrices. Rationale (#2284): reuses the existing primitives (`dependsOn` already declares lookup cascades; `visibleWhen` is already the field-level CEL predicate, same engine/env), is strictly more expressive (role/tenant/time gating via `current_user`, not just sibling-field cascades), and is AI-authoring-friendly (`"record.country == 'cn'"` reads as prose).
- **Static vs query-backed: both paths exist.** Small stable dictionaries → static options + `option.visibleWhen`. Large/changing datasets (country/state as data, org trees, catalogs) → `lookup + dependsOn` with the dependency folded into the query filter (#2215). Decision rule documented in `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`.

## Shipped

- **Spec** (framework): `SelectOption.visibleWhen` on `@objectstack/spec` — shared by data `Field.options` and view `FormField.options`.
- **objectui client** (#2284, v12.0.0):
  - `@object-ui/core` evaluator: `resolveVisibleOptions` / `isOptionGroupGated` / `resolveDependsOnFields` / `isValueStillOffered` (`packages/core/src/evaluator/optionRules.ts`), reusing the canonical `evalFieldPredicate` against the live record + `current_user`.
  - Form renderer: reactively narrows a dependent select's option list, gates with a "Select {parent} first" hint while a `dependsOn` field is empty, and clears a now-invalid child value when the parent changes.
  - Standalone `SelectField` widget: same resolution via `dependentValues` + global predicate scope. Options pass through `ObjectForm`/`sectionFields` untouched, so spec-authored predicates reach the widget.
- **Dependent (query-backed) lookups**: #2215 — gate unlocks on parent selection; the cascade filter is enforced on every candidate surface (popover + table picker).
- **Showcase example**: `examples/schema-catalog/src/schemas/fields-select/cascading-options.json` (country → province cascading pair).
- **Authoring guidance**: `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` § "Cascading & role-gated select options" (decision rule + security line).
- **Unit tests**: `optionRules.test.ts`, `SelectField.cascade.test.tsx`, `form-cascading-select.test.tsx`.

## Remaining

> ⚠️ Security line (unchanged from #2284): hiding an option client-side is **UX, not a security boundary**. When an option is gated for authorization reasons, the server must also reject writes of its value — today nothing server-side blocks an out-of-set picklist value.

- [ ] **framework — server-side enforcement**: on write, evaluate the submitted value's option `visibleWhen` against the record (+ actor) in the `@objectstack/objectql` rule path and reject when FALSE — alongside `requiredWhen`/`readonlyWhen`, mirroring `stripReadonlyWhenFields`. *(Cross-repo: status unverified from objectui — needs a framework-repo issue / verification.)*
- [ ] **objectui — live e2e**: cascading pair driven end-to-end (change parent → child options re-filter → stale child value cleared), extending the `e2e/live/field-conditional-rules.spec.ts` pattern; add the out-of-set submit-rejection case once server enforcement lands.
- [ ] **ADR**: record the B3 decision (per-option `visibleWhen` + `dependsOn` over `optionsWhen`/`validFor`; dual-side enforcement) as a companion to ADR-0036 (B2).
- [ ] **Role-gated option demo** *(carried from #2284)*: showcase `visibleWhen: "'admin' in current_user.roles"` with the matching server-side rejection.
- [ ] **Build-time CEL guardrail** *(carried from #2284)*: statically check option-predicate field refs/literals against the referenced field's value domain to catch authoring typos (`country == 'chna'`).

## References

- #2284 — design decision + client implementation (closed)
- #2215 — dependent lookups: gate + query-filter on all surfaces (closed)
- ADR-0036 — B2 field conditional rules (`docs/adr/0036-field-conditional-rules.md`)
- objectui v12.0.0 changelog (`packages/core/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/fields/CHANGELOG.md`, entry `226fde9`)
